# Hótel Laugar

> A peaceful summer base for discovering North Iceland. Hótel Laugar (also written Hotel Laugar) is a privately owned summer hotel with 57 rooms in three white houses by a pond in Reykjadalur, on the Diamond Circle: Goðafoss 15 km, Lake Mývatn 30 km, Húsavík 40 km, Akureyri about 50 km. Restaurant, breakfast included, lounge and bar, the village geothermal pool next door. Open 31 May to 22 August 2027. A boarding school the rest of the year.

## The hotel
- Address: Austurhlíðarvegur, 650 Laugar, Reykjadalur, North Iceland. GPS 65.7226153, -17.3594295. Just off the ring road between Akureyri and Mývatn.
- Owners: Stella and Eyþór (Hótel Laugar ehf., kt. 610616-0460). Operating licence LG-REK-011367. Manager: Astrid Hauptmann.
- Summer 2027 at the hotel, 31 May to 22 August: a summer day at Laugar (breakfast, the pool, happy hour, dinner) and the Diamond Circle by road: https://hotellaugar.is/summer/
- 57 rooms in three guest houses: Tröllasteinn (35 rooms, lift, two wheelchair accessible rooms, beside the car park), Álfasteinn (7 rooms, by the pool, stairs), Fjall (15 rooms, up the hill with the best view, the triple room, stairs). Reception, restaurant, lounge and terrace are in the main building by the pond.
- Rooms: doubles that can be made up as twins, one natural triple, extra bed for a third guest on request at extra cost, baby cribs on request; rooms take one or two guests. Private bathroom, linen and towels, hairdryer, soap, shampoo and body wash, kettle with coffee and tea, adjustable heating. No TVs. Free Wi-Fi in every building.
- Included with every stay: breakfast, Wi-Fi, parking, towels for the village pool on request. Laundry at a cost. Lunch packs on request at a cost. Free porter on request for Álfasteinn and Fjall.
- Check-in 16:00 to 22:00 (call on the day for later), check-out by 11:00. Reception 07:00 to 12:00 and 16:00 to 22:00.
- Season 2027: 31 May to 22 August. Closed the rest of the year (the buildings are a boarding school).

## Food and drink
- Breakfast buffet 07:00 to 10:00, included. Dinner 18:00 to 21:00 with local produce such as Arctic char and Icelandic lamb; reservation recommended, by phone +354 844 3259 or email (no online table booking). Drinks 16:00 to 22:00, happy hour 16:00 to 18:00. Lounge and sun terrace open around the clock. Outside guests welcome for breakfast and dinner. Gluten free on request.

## Around
- The village pool Sundlaugin Laugum is a minute on foot: big outdoor pool, two hot tubs, children’s pool, cold tub, sauna, outdoor shower, open 10:00 to 21:00 in summer, paid at the pool; the gym upstairs is paid separately. Golf course at Laugar and horse riding nearby, paid separately.
- Road distances from the hotel: Goðafoss 15 km, Lake Mývatn 30 km, Húsavík (whale watching) 40 km, Akureyri and its airport about 50 km through the Vaðlaheiði tunnel, Dettifoss about 90 km, Ásbyrgi about 100 km.
- Day tours: private tours with Kip (kip.is), including Askja; husky cart rides and kennel visits with Snow Dogs Iceland at Vallholt, about 13 km from the hotel.

## Explore North Iceland from the hotel
- Reykjadalur: the hotel’s own valley. An evening, or a slow morning. Best: Every day of the season. The valley of the Reykjadalsá river, where the hotel stands in the village of Laugar: a place of its own, and a peaceful summer base for discovering North Iceland. https://hotellaugar.is/explore/reykjadalur/
- Goðafoss: 15 km by road, 15 min west. An hour, or half a day. Best: Early morning or late evening. The waterfall of the gods on the Skjálfandafljót, where the law speaker is said to have thrown the old idols into the river in the year 1000. The closest of the big sights, 15 km from the hotel, and light enough to visit at midnight in June. https://hotellaugar.is/explore/godafoss/
- Lake Mývatn: 30 km by road, 30 min east. A full day. Best: Any day; a breezy one if possible. A shallow lake in a landscape still being made, 30 km east of the hotel: pseudo craters, lava castles, boiling mud and a geothermal lagoon for the evening. Allow a full day. https://hotellaugar.is/explore/myvatn/
- The Diamond Circle: About 250 km by road, 4 to 5 h. One long day, better two. Best: June and July, light all night. Goðafoss, Húsavík, Ásbyrgi, Dettifoss and Mývatn make the Diamond Circle, and Laugar is on it. Drive it in one long summer day, or take it a piece at a time over two or three. https://hotellaugar.is/explore/diamond-circle/
- Húsavík: 40 km by road, 40 min north. Half a day. Best: June to August. The whale watching capital of Europe, on Skjálfandi bay, 40 km north of the hotel. Tours leave the harbour through the summer, and the sea baths on the cliff above town are there for afterwards. https://hotellaugar.is/explore/husavik/
- Dettifoss and Ásbyrgi: 90 and 100 km by road, 1 h 20 and 1 h 30. A full day for both. Best: June to August. Europe’s most powerful waterfall and the horseshoe canyon said to be the hoofprint of Óðinn’s horse, both in Vatnajökull National Park, about an hour and a half from the hotel. Allow a full day for both. https://hotellaugar.is/explore/dettifoss-asbyrgi/
- Akureyri: 50 km by road, 45 min west. A day, with Goðafoss on the way. Best: A rainy day, or the day you fly. The capital of the north at the head of Eyjafjörður: the church and its steps, the botanical garden, the pool and the airport for domestic flights. Through the tunnel from Laugar, with Goðafoss on the way. https://hotellaugar.is/explore/akureyri/

## Booking
- Book directly on the website (Book direct), which opens the hotel's own Godo booking page with the chosen dates and guests: https://hotellaugar.is/
- Best available rate when booking direct, plus complimentary early check-in and late check-out when available. Rates: a non-refundable rate paid now, or a refundable rate secured with card details, verified with 3D Secure. Terms are shown before payment.
- Contact: +354 466 4009, WhatsApp +354 844 3259, hotellaugar@hotellaugar.is, Instagram @hotellaugar.

## Questions and answers
### Where is Hotel Laugar located?
In the village of Laugar in Reykjadalur, North Iceland, on the Diamond Circle: Goðafoss is 15 km away, Lake Mývatn 30 km, Húsavík 40 km and Akureyri about 50 km.

### Is Hotel Laugar open all year?
No. The buildings are a boarding school for most of the year, and the hotel opens in the Icelandic summer holidays. See Summer in North Iceland at Hótel Laugar.

### When is Hotel Laugar open in 2027?
From 31 May to 22 August 2027.

### When are check-in and check-out?
Check-in from 16:00 to 22:00, check-out by 11:00. Arriving after 22:00? Call us that day and we tell you how to check in late. Early check-in or late check-out when a room is free, for guests who book direct.

### When is reception open?
From 07:00 to 12:00 and from 16:00 to 22:00, in the main building.

### How do I get to my room?
Drive up to the main building, past the swimming pool to the flags, and leave your luggage in the car: the rooms are in the other buildings. Check in and collect your key cards, then drive or walk to your house. Tröllasteinn is beside the car park with a lift. Álfasteinn is a short drive round the pool, Fjall a short drive up the hill. Both are a minute’s walk by path, and a porter is available free on request.

### Is the hotel wheelchair accessible?
Tröllasteinn has a lift, direct access from the car park and two wheelchair accessible rooms. The restaurant is also accessible, by the outdoor path. Álfasteinn and Fjall are reached by stairs. If you cannot climb stairs, please let us know in advance, as not every room is reached by a lift.

### Is parking free?
Yes, free and ample parking at every building.

### Does Hotel Laugar have Wi-Fi?
Yes, free in all buildings. The signal can drop while you walk between them.

### Is there a laundry service?
Yes, laundry service is available at a cost. For a one night stay we can wash what goes in the dryer. From two nights, clothes can also air dry.

### What kinds of room are there?
57 rooms: one natural triple, and doubles that can be made up as twins. An extra bed for a third guest can be added on request, at extra cost, and baby cribs are available on request. Rooms take one or two guests.

### What is in the room?
A private bathroom, linen, towels and a bathmat, hairdryer, soap, shampoo and body wash, a kettle with coffee and tea, and adjustable heating. There are no TVs: for most of the year the houses are a school. Wifi is free in every building.

### Which house should I choose?
Tröllasteinn if you want the lift, the car park at the door and the direct path to the restaurant. Álfasteinn for its own parking by the pool. Fjall for the view and the guest lounge. If you cannot climb stairs, let us know in advance.

### Is breakfast included?
Yes, breakfast is included with every stay: a rich buffet from 07:00 to 10:00 in the restaurant. Gluten free on request.

### Does Hotel Laugar have a restaurant?
Yes, in the main building. Dinner is served from 18:00 to 21:00, with local produce such as Arctic char and Icelandic lamb, and drinks from 16:00 to 22:00.

### Can I book dinner at Hotel Laugar?
Yes, and a reservation is recommended. Just call +354 844 3259 or email hotellaugar@hotellaugar.is; there is no online booking for the restaurant. Outside guests are welcome for breakfast and dinner too.

### Is there a bar?
Drinks are served from 16:00 to 22:00, with happy hour from 16:00 to 18:00. The lounge and terrace are open to guests around the clock.

### Can I get a packed lunch?
Yes, lunch packs are made on request, at a cost. Large groups, please order a day in advance.

### Is there a swimming pool near Hotel Laugar?
The village pool, Sundlaugin Laugum, is a minute’s walk: a big outdoor pool, two hot tubs, a children’s pool, a cold tub, a sauna and an outdoor shower. In summer it is open 10:00 to 21:00; entry is paid at the pool, and the gym upstairs is paid separately. Towels are complimentary at the hotel reception.

### How far is Hotel Laugar from Lake Mývatn?
Lake Mývatn is 30 km by road.

### How far is Hotel Laugar from Goðafoss?
Goðafoss is 15 km by road.

### How far is Hotel Laugar from Húsavík?
Húsavík, for whale watching, is 40 km by road. Akureyri is about 50 km, Dettifoss about 90 km and Ásbyrgi about 100 km.

### Is Hotel Laugar a good base for the Diamond Circle?
Yes. Laugar is close to every stop on the Diamond Circle: Goðafoss 15 km, Lake Mývatn 30 km, Húsavík and its whale watching 40 km, Dettifoss about 90 km and Ásbyrgi about 100 km.

### Is Hotel Laugar suitable for families?
Yes. One room is a natural triple, an extra bed for a third guest is available on request at extra cost, and baby cribs are available on request. The village pool next door has a children’s pool.

### How do I find the hotel?
Hótel Laugar, Austurhlíðarvegur, 650 Laugar, in Reykjadalur, just off the ring road between Akureyri and Mývatn. Open in Google Maps.

### Can I book directly with Hotel Laugar?
Yes, right here. Choose your dates and you book on the hotel’s own booking page.

### What are the benefits of booking directly?
Our best available rate, plus complimentary early check-in and late check-out when available.

### Can I request early check-in or late check-out?
Yes. When you book directly, early check-in and late check-out are complimentary when available.

### What are the cancellation terms?
You choose when you book: a non-refundable rate paid now, or a refundable rate secured with your card details, verified with 3D Secure. The exact terms for each are shown before you pay.

### Do you take groups?
Yes. Write to hotellaugar@hotellaugar.is with dates and numbers.
